text: 中国人民银行上海总部发布2026年上半年长三角地区货币信贷运行情况。6月末，长三角地区本外币各项存款余额91.89万亿元，同比增长8.3%。其中，人民币存款余额88.8万亿元，同比增长8.2%；外币存款余额4545亿美元，同比增长14.4%。
text_en: The PBOC Shanghai Head Office released H1 2026 monetary and credit operations in the Yangtze River Delta region. At end-June, domestic and foreign currency deposits in the region totaled 91.89 trillion yuan, up 8.3% year-on-year. Among these, RMB deposits were 88.8 trillion yuan, up 8.2% year-on-year; foreign currency deposits were $454.5 billion, up 14.4% year-on-year.
